description.short: Gower Adventures offers guided outdoor activities on the Gower Peninsula year-round, including sea kayaking from Oxwich Bay, rock climbing at Three Cliffs Bay, caving, canoeing, abseiling, gorge walking, and body boarding at Caswell Beach.
description.shortNote: Drafted from verified website content and external listings. Needs editorial review before publishing.
description.full:
Gower Adventures provides guided outdoor activity days on the world-famous Gower Peninsula — the UK's first Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty — operating year-round for families, groups, couples, and individuals. Led by a team of qualified and experienced instructors, the company offers a wide range of activities across the peninsula's distinctive limestone coastline and beaches.

Sea kayaking trips depart from Oxwich Bay, with options spanning three difficulty levels: sheltered inland water for beginners, sheltered coastal bays for intermediate paddlers, and exposed coastline routes for advanced groups. Rock climbing and abseiling sessions take place on the dramatic limestone cliffs at Three Cliffs Bay, alongside caving, canoeing, gorge walking, gorge scrambling, and body boarding at Caswell Beach.

Multi-activity days are available, allowing guests to combine two or more activities in a single session. Sessions typically run for around four hours including a lunch break. Equipment, instruction, safety briefing, and insurance are all included. Gower Adventures welcomes families with children from age 6, dog-friendly activities (climbing and abseiling), Scout and Guide groups, and special occasions including team-building events.
